title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a product engineering team building AI-powered business communication software. You will own customer-facing features from early discovery through production, helping shape the product roadmap through close contact with users.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Take features from concept and prototyping through implementation, deployment, and iteration.

 - Build and evolve the platform using TypeScript, React, Node.js, and NestJS.

 - Engage with customers through support, feedback sessions, and user testing to understand their needs.

 - Break down opportunities into focused releases that deliver customer value, then improve them using feedback and metrics.

 - Contribute to feature prioritization and product roadmap decisions for AI-powered voice services.

 - Integrate AI capabilities into customer-facing applications and consider relevant European data protection and AI regulations.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 5 years of fullstack engineering experience building and delivering SaaS products.

 - Substantial hands-on experience across both frontend and backend, including shipping end-to-end web features.

 - Production experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js; NestJS experience is preferred.

 - Experience with customer-facing product discovery, rapid experimentation, and using metrics to guide decisions.

 - Comfort working directly with customers and collaborating with business teams to understand user needs.

 - Native German proficiency and fluent English.

 - Experience with LLM integrations, fast-moving startups, or AI services is useful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: €80,000 to €120,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

Remote, based in Germany.

description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Supabase is the backend of choice for a growing wave of AI-native builders, and we're deepening structured partnerships with the platforms they build on top of — Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. These partners' teams are talking to thousands of developers and agents who need exactly what we build—a full backend platform with Postgres at the core—without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right partner SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern, AI-ready backend.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Platform Solutions Architect to join our Success Team and help embed Supabase into the Solutions and Engineering communities with AI Builders.

You’ll work closely with Partner Solutions Architects and Partner Engineers at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, helping us proactively identify builder problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real developer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions of AI-native apps and agents.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll focus on three core pillars:


TECHNICAL EVANGELISM & EDUCATION

 - Build deep relationships with Technical counterparts at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, focusing initially on defined use cases and agent/app-migration motions.

 - Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give partner SAs the fluency to position Supabase.

 - Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable immediately legible.

 - Partner with SAs at these companies on active opportunities to move deals forward and feeding technical pipeline intelligence back to the alliance lead.


TECHNICAL SUPPORT & ENABLEMENT

 - Resolve blockers for partner SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with the builders they support.

 - Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets.

 - Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities.

 - Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced, influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics across the Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable partnerships.


CONTENT CREATION & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

 - Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations built on Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable.

 - Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and partner-sponsored events (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI dev days, Vercel Ship, Lovable community events).

 - Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for partner SAs.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of experience in technical roles with deep hands-on experience building on modern AI infrastructure. Previous experience working at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, Lovable (or a similar AI builder platform) or as a partner to one is required.

 - Understand how partner SAs at AI builder platforms are incentivized, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences developer decisions.

 - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease.

 - Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js, plus fluency with AI/agent tooling (LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks).

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly to build a playbook from scratch.

 - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers building the next generation of AI-native products.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Location: London, Munich, Amsterdam, Paris, Lisbon
About the Department
The Specialist Solutions Engineering team at Cloudflare is a group of trusted technical advisors who partner with our customers to solve their most complex security and performance challenges. We work hand-in-hand with the sales organization to navigate the entire customer journey, from initial discovery and solution design to proof-of-concept and implementation. We are passionate about technology and dedicated to helping our customers understand and leverage the full power of Cloudflare's global network to achieve their business critical objectives.
About the Role
As a Senior Solutions Engineer Specialist, you will be a pivotal technical expert and strategic advisor, focusing on the Cloudflare One product suite. You will partner with our sales team and engage directly with our customers to architect and demonstrate how our SASE platform can solve their unique security, performance, and reliability needs. Your expertise will be crucial in guiding prospects through complex technical evaluations, ensuring they have the confidence to adopt Cloudflare as a core component of their IT and security infrastructure.
This role requires a blend of deep technical curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine passion for helping customers transform their network and security architecture. Candidates are expected to actively use AI tools in their day-to-day life for research, preparation, automation, or customer engagement.
Responsibilities
• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to our customers, helping them architect the optimal solution for their business needs using the Cloudflare One product suite.
• Stay at the forefront of AI-era security challenges by developing expertise in how enterprises govern and secure AI tool adoption, including Shadow AI visibility, data loss prevention for AI applications, MCP server access controls and Agentic AI Governance.
• Guide qualified prospects through the solution design and proof-of-value stages, effectively demonstrating the key capabilities and value of the Cloudflare One portfolio.
• Collaborate with sales partners to consistently achieve pipeline generation and revenue goals.
• Analyze customer IT landscapes and security requirements to develop robust architectures that support their strategic objectives.
• Clearly articulate the benefits and technical differentiators of the Cloudflare One product portfolio against competing solutions.
• Enhance customer retention by identifying, capturing, and communicating product gaps or feature requests to internal product and engineering teams.
• Collaborate with Product Teams by being the voice of our customers by sharing insights, trends, and product gaps to help shape the product suite and solution roadmap.
Qualifications
Successful candidates are curious, customer-focused, and have a passion for learning. We are looking for individuals with a strong background in technical sales or systems engineering who can effectively communicate complex concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
Key Qualifications:
• 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Sales, Solutions/Systems Engineering, or a related field.
• Active adoption of the use of AI tools in professional day to day workflows and knowledge on AI security concepts relevant to enterprise customers: Securing employee AI tool usage, Governing AI application access, and understanding the data leakage risks posed by generative AI tools
• Demonstrated experience presenting technical solutions and communicating the value of network and security transformation to senior-level executives.
• Deep understanding of the modern cybersecurity landscape, including common threats (e.g., malware, ransomware, phishing, botnets) and mitigation strategies.
• Fundamental knowledge of customer network and application architectures, including hybrid environments leveraging public clouds (Azure, AWS, GCP).
• Solid grasp of SASE concepts and Zero Trust networking architectures.
• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Secure Web Gateway (SWG), CASB, DLP, DNS security (including DNS over HTTPS), Identity Provider (IdP) integration (SAML, OTP), and SIEM/log analytics platforms.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:
• Fluent in English (written & spoken), Russian and/or Hebrew
• Proficiency with networking fundamentals,
